verdict.rationale: There is no first-party guardrails feature in the evidence. Guardrails can only be built by hand: arbitrary functions can serve as preprocessing/postprocessing nodes (comm-3), deterministic hand-coded steps can be mixed with LLM steps (docs-1), and interrupts can pause execution for human review before continuing (docs-4, gh-7). That supports a do-it-yourself way to validate, transform, or block content, but nothing ships ready-made. Missing for 10: a documented input/output guardrail API, built-in validators or content-safety filters, documented block/transform semantics, and independent corroboration of guardrail usage.
